---

applyTo: "src/**/*.cs"

---
All Controllers must be located in APIServer Controllers folder

All Mapper relations must be in the Mapper file in Busines Mapper folder

All Business logic is done in Handlers the file name needs to end in --Handler.cs must be located in Busines Handlers folder

All Services is done in Handlers the file name needs to end in --Service.cs must be located in Busines Services folder

All ViewModel must be located in Busines ViewFolder folder

All Responses must be located in Busines Response folder

ViewModels and Responses need to be mapped in the Mapper file in Busines Mapper folder

All delete function from DB must be a soft Delete by toggling a "active" parameter to false

All querys must return all active = true results by default unless indicated otherwise

All photos or pictures must be converted to a web size and thumbnail size and both uploaded to a public S3 bucket, the database holds the public URL and the thumbnail URL

Users with SuperAdmin can add admin users and Clients, and modify Client data

Users with Admin can view and modify Client data if the client is assigned to them

Users with Client role can only view their own data

Every new or updated module needs to have the unit tests created or updated to cover the new or modified code
